description.value:
A tendril of dark energy lances from you to touch a creature within range, draining its life. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw: on a success it takes 2d8 necrotic damage and the power ends; on a failure it takes 4d8 necrotic damage, and until the power ends you can use your action each turn to automatically deal it another 4d8 necrotic damage. The power ends early if you take any other action, if the target leaves the power's range, or if it gains total cover from you.

Each time the power damages the target, you regain hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt. When cast using a force slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 5
